name: Sofia
source:
The strongest wizard in the elf country. 
She has absolute confidence in her magic and has never lost to anyone when it comes to it.

Because she has a high pride and speaks harshly, she is often thought to be selfish. 

She prides himself on the magical prowess of the elven race and subscribes to elven supremacy.
She clearly looks down on humans who can't handle magic, and she also has a sadistic side that likes to torture them as a target for magic.
